draft.shortGloss: to put; to keep; to place
draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and helpful, focusing on the simple task of tidying up
notes: Transitive verb; takes ने (ne) in perfective tenses (जैसे: मैंने किताब रखी — I put the book).
Also used with nouns to mean 'to have' or 'to maintain', e.g., ध्यान रखना (to take care / pay attention), नाम रखना (to name).

notes: रखना (rakhna) is one of the most versatile verbs in Hindi. It covers both placing an object in a specific spot and the long-term act of keeping or retaining something.
Be careful not to confuse this with लेना (lena - to take). While लेना involves moving something toward yourself, रखना is about the placement of an object at a destination.
